data.summary: The reviews are highly suspicious. A pool contractor with only 5 total reviews, all perfect 5-star ratings, and no presence on any other review platform is extremely unusual. The reviews themselves are very brief and generic, lacking the specific details (project costs, timelines, design elements, problems encountered and resolved) that characterize authentic contractor reviews. The empty review from 'Dallas guide' is a major red flag. This pattern suggests possible review manipulation or a very new/inactive business.

All reviews are 5-star with no constructive feedback
Vague, generic praise lacking specific project details
One review is completely empty text
No reviews on any other platform (Angi, Houzz, Yelp)

positive_evidence: One review mentions responsive service for issues

Reviews span multiple years (4 years to 6 months)
